findings.title: Prior blocking findings resolved
findings.detail: plan_review-1 flagged `tests/test_a.py` and `pkg/__init__.py` as non-existent. The brief now marks them as scratch files *(new)* that each test creates inside its own tempdir, not files in this repo. Resolved.

findings.title: Hook fixture needs an unborn variant
findings.detail: The safety rules say to reuse the hook fixture at `tests/run.rs:1225`. But `Hooked::new` builds on `Fixture::new(0)`, which is a repo that already has commits. A9 needs an empty `git init` repo with the same hook, so dev will have to factor out the hook-writing code (or add a constructor that leaves HEAD unborn) rather than reuse `Hooked::new` as it is.

findings.title: The up-front unborn probe adds 2 git spawns to every run in a repo with commits
findings.detail: The brief puts `head_is_unborn` (`symbolic-ref` + `rev-parse HEAD`) before scope dispatch whenever `--base` is absent. So every hook run in a repo with commits gains two git processes. Behaviour stays the same (the no-go is respected), and the ≤3-spawn Bound check depends on probing first. Probing only after the chain fails would give 7 spawns on an unborn repo. This is acceptable; dev should just know it is a deliberate cost and mention it in ADR 0025.

findings.title: Real-pytest QA needs a pytest source
findings.detail: There is no `pytest` on PATH here. `uvx --offline pytest --version` works (pytest 9.2.0). The A1 real-pytest check can run with `GERENUK_PYTEST` pointing at a one-line wrapper script that execs `uvx --offline pytest "$@"`. Worth saying so in the brief so QA doesn't report it as cannot_run.

findings.title: Code references verified
findings.detail: All of these exist as described: `cli::resolve_base` at src/cli.rs:467, the `Diff::WorkingTree` arm in `impacted_run` (:597), `upfront_reason` / `fast_suite` / `Runner::discover` in that order, `Git::run` / `try_run` / private `output`, `resolve_last_commit` falling back to `resolve_base(None)`, `Reason::ALL: [Self; 10]` (becomes 11), `ImpactRun.changed: Option`, `impact::run_all(&ChangedSymbols, ..)` (needs a sibling, as the brief says), fallback.rs's null-report convention, the guide `LINE_CAP` of 60 and `triage_names_every_run_all_reason_by_its_label`, triage.md at exactly 60 lines, ADR 0024's root-commit note, and the highest ADR being 0024, so 0025 is free. None of it is built yet: there is no `head_is_unborn` and no `UnbornHead`. The plan fits one session: one variant, one git helper, one cli outcome, tests, an ADR and a guide trim.
